0: You draw a card and lose 1 life. Proliferate.

blocked_sentences: −2: Target creature becomes a Treasure artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color" and loses all other card types and abilities.

needs.what: a one-shot, indefinite (no duration) type-replacement effect on a target permanent: its card types become exactly the named ones (Artifact) with the named subtype (Treasure), other card types and their subtypes are lost, and its colours and supertypes are left untouched -- e.g. an `animate` with `exact: true` and a `keep_colors: true` flag (or `colors` omitted meaning unchanged), combined with `lose_all_abilities` and a permanent `grant_ability` of the Treasure mana ability
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `animate` with `duration: permanent` and `exact: true` is the only one-shot op that removes card types, but in characteristics.py an exact animation sets `colors = set(temp.colors)`, so omitting colors makes the creature colorless -- Vraska's Treasure keeps its colours. Non-exact `animate` only adds types, so the permanent would stay a creature. The `set_types` static removes types but only exists as a static on an Aura-like source, not as a resolving effect
